mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher when GDP increases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when unemployment exceeds 9%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rises and employment falls, it signals economic instability, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: No negative returns when both proxies indicate instability.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate in a tightening cycle may reduce borrowing, negatively impacting S&P 500.
failure_condition: Positive returns when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production suggests strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns do not increase with rising industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: Excessive inflation may lead to rate hikes, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
GDP growth paired with rising federal funds may indicate conflicting policies, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns when both GDP and FEDFUNDS rise.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts surge in late-cycle expansion may signal a peak, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns when housing starts exceed 700K in this regime.
